# R script to plot dS boxplot to compare between different clades and different gene categories (ancestral,autosomal and neo-Z)


## Configuration
```{r setup,include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "C:/Users/Julia/Desktop/IRT3")
library(castor)
library(ape)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
```



## 1. Meliphagidae data
```{r}
# 1. NEO
paml_neo_mel <- "C:/Users/Julia/Desktop/IRT3/Meliphagidae/PAML_neo_NR"


nwk_trees_neo_mel <- list.files(path=paml_neo_mel, pattern = "\\.nwk$", full.names=TRUE, recursive=TRUE )
print(nwk_trees_neo_mel)

results_table_neo_mel <- data.frame(Gene = character(),
                                Average_Ingroup_Distance = numeric(),
                                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (file_path in nwk_trees_neo_mel) {
  
  
  file_name <- basename(file_path)
  
  gene_name <- gsub("_dS_tree\\.nwk$", "", file_name)
  
  tree <- read.tree(file_path)
  
  rooted_tree <- root(tree, outgroup = "Tae_gut", resolve.root = TRUE)
  
  all_distances <- get_all_distances_to_root(rooted_tree)
  
  Ntips <- length(rooted_tree$tip.label)
  
  tip_distances <- setNames(all_distances[1:Ntips], rooted_tree$tip.label)
  
  ingroup_distances <- tip_distances[names(tip_distances) !="Tae_gut"] 
  #ingroup_distances <- tip_distances[names(tip_distances) != "Pel_cri","Gor_goi",]
  #ingroup_distances <- tip_distances[!names(tip_distances) %in% c("Pel_cri", "Gor_goi")] 
  mean_ingroup_distance <- mean(ingroup_distances)
  
  
  cat("\n=====================================\n")
  cat("Processing Gene:", gene_name, "\n")
  cat("Individual Ingroup Distances:\n")
  print(ingroup_distances)
  cat("Average Ingroup Root-to-Tip Distance:", mean_ingroup_distance, "\n")
  
  results_table_neo_mel <- rbind(results_table_neo_mel, data.frame(Gene = gene_name, 
                                                           Average_Ingroup_Distance = mean_ingroup_distance))
}

total_average_neo_mel <- mean(results_table_neo_mel$Average_Ingroup_Distance, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(total_average_neo_mel)
```

## 2. Threskiornithidae data
```{r}
#1. NEO
paml_neo_ibis <- "C:/Users/Julia/Desktop/IRT3/Ibis/PAML_neo_NR"

nwk_trees_neo_ibis <- list.files(path=paml_neo_ibis, pattern = "\\.nwk$", full.names=TRUE, recursive=TRUE )
print(nwk_trees_neo_ibis)

results_table_neo_ibis <- data.frame(Gene = character(),
                                Average_Ingroup_Distance = numeric(),
                                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (file_path in nwk_trees_neo_ibis) {
  
  file_name <- basename(file_path)
  gene_name <- gsub("_dS_tree\\.nwk$", "", file_name)
  tree <- read.tree(file_path)
  
  # --- Dynamic Outgroup Selection ---
  # Check if "Pel_cri" is in the tree. If not, use "Gor_goi"
  if ("Pel_cri" %in% tree$tip.label) {
    current_outgroup <- "Pel_cri"
  } else if ("Gor_goi" %in% tree$tip.label) {
    current_outgroup <- "Gor_goi"
  } else {
    warning(paste("Neither 'Pel_cri' nor 'Gor_goi' found in", gene_name, "- skipping tree."))
    next # Skip to the next file if neither exists
  }
  
  # Root the tree with the selected outgroup
  rooted_tree <- root(tree, outgroup = current_outgroup, resolve.root = TRUE)
  
  all_distances <- get_all_distances_to_root(rooted_tree)
  Ntips <- length(rooted_tree$tip.label)
  tip_distances <- setNames(all_distances[1:Ntips], rooted_tree$tip.label)
  
  # --- Dynamic Ingroup Distances ---
  # Exclude BOTH potential outgroups from the ingroup calculations to keep data consistent
  ingroup_distances <- tip_distances[!names(tip_distances) %in% c("Pel_cri", "Gor_goi")]
  mean_ingroup_distance <- mean(ingroup_distances)
  
  cat("\n=====================================\n")
  cat("Processing Gene:", gene_name, "\n")
  cat("Outgroup Used:", current_outgroup, "\n")
  cat("Individual Ingroup Distances:\n")
  print(ingroup_distances)
  cat("Average Ingroup Root-to-Tip Distance:", mean_ingroup_distance, "\n")
  
  results_table_neo_ibis <- rbind(results_table_neo_ibis, data.frame(Gene = gene_name, 
                                                           Average_Ingroup_Distance = mean_ingroup_distance))
}

total_average_neo_ibis <- mean(results_table_neo_ibis$Average_Ingroup_Distance, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(total_average_neo_ibis)
```

```{r}
IQR <- Q3 - Q1
lower_bound <- Q1 -1.5*IQR
upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5*IQR

filtered_results_table_ancestral_parrots <- results_table_ancestral_parrots[
  results_table_ancestral_parrots$Average_Ingroup_Distance >= lower_bound & 
    results_table_ancestral_parrots$Average_Ingroup_Distance <= upper_bound, 
]

filtered_average_ancestral_parrots <- mean(filtered_results_table_ancestral_parrots$Average_Ingroup_Distance, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(filtered_average_ancestral_parrots)
```

```{r}
# 1. NEO
paml_neo_sylviida <- "C:/Users/Julia/Desktop/IRT3/Sylviida/PAML_neo_NR"

results_table_neo_sylviida <- data.frame(Gene = character(),
                                Average_Ingroup_Distance = numeric(),
                                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (file_path in nwk_trees_neo_sylviida) {
  
  
  file_name <- basename(file_path)
  
  gene_name <- gsub("_dS_tree\\.nwk$", "", file_name)
  
  tree <- read.tree(file_path)
  
  rooted_tree <- root(tree, outgroup = "Tae_gut", resolve.root = TRUE)
  
  all_distances <- get_all_distances_to_root(rooted_tree)
  
  Ntips <- length(rooted_tree$tip.label)
  
  tip_distances <- setNames(all_distances[1:Ntips], rooted_tree$tip.label)
  
  ingroup_distances <- tip_distances[names(tip_distances) !="Tae_gut"] 
  #ingroup_distances <- tip_distances[names(tip_distances) != "Pel_cri","Gor_goi",]
  #ingroup_distances <- tip_distances[!names(tip_distances) %in% c("Pel_cri", "Gor_goi")] 
  mean_ingroup_distance <- mean(ingroup_distances)
  
  
  cat("\n=====================================\n")
  cat("Processing Gene:", gene_name, "\n")
  cat("Individual Ingroup Distances:\n")
  print(ingroup_distances)
  cat("Average Ingroup Root-to-Tip Distance:", mean_ingroup_distance, "\n")
  
  results_table_neo_sylviida <- rbind(results_table_neo_sylviida, data.frame(Gene = gene_name, 
                                                           Average_Ingroup_Distance = mean_ingroup_distance))
```

## 5. Plotting 
```{r}
# 1. COMBINE DATASETS
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  
  "Meliphagidae" = bind_rows(
    "neo"        = results_table_neo_mel, 
    "autosomal" = results_table_autosomal_mel, 
    "ancestral" = results_table_ancestral_mel,
    .id = "Gene_type"
  ),
  "Sylvioidea"     = bind_rows(
    "neo"        = results_table_neo_sylviida,
    "autosomal" = results_table_autosomal_syl,
    "ancestral" = results_table_ancestral_syl,
    .id = "Gene_type"
  ),
  "Psittaciformes" = bind_rows(
    "neo"          = results_table_neo_parrots,
    "autosomal"    = results_table_autosomal_parrots,
    "ancestral"    = results_table_ancestral_parrots,
    .id = "Gene_type"
  ),
  "Threskiornithidae" = bind_rows(
    "neo"        = results_table_neo_ibis, 
    "autosomal" = results_table_autosomal_ibis,
    "ancestral" = results_table_ancestral_ibis,
    .id = "Gene_type"
  ),
  .id = "clade"
)


filter_combined_data <- bind_rows(
  
  "Meliphagidae" = bind_rows(
    "neo"        = filtered_results_table_neo_mel, 
    "autosomal" = filtered_results_table_autosomal_mel, 
    "ancestral" = filtered_results_table_ancestral_mel,
    .id = "Gene_type"
  ),
  "Sylvioidea"     = bind_rows(
    "neo"        = filtered_results_table_neo_syl,
    "autosomal" = filtered_results_table_autosomal_syl,
    "ancestral" = filtered_results_table_ancestral_syl,
    .id = "Gene_type"
  ),
  "Psittaciformes" = bind_rows(
    "neo"          = filtered_results_table_neo_parrots,
    "autosomal"    = filtered_results_table_autosomal_parrots,
    "ancestral"    = filtered_results_table_ancestral_parrots,
    .id = "Gene_type"
  ),
  "Threskiornithidae" = bind_rows(
    "neo"        = filtered_results_table_neo_ibis, 
    "autosomal" = filtered_results_table_autosomal_ibis,
    "ancestral" = filtered_results_table_ancestral_ibis,
    .id = "Gene_type"
  ),
  .id = "clade"
)

#set the order
filter_combined_data$clade <- factor(filter_combined_data$clade,
  levels = c("Meliphagidae", "Sylvioidea", "Psittaciformes", "Threskiornithidae"))

# 2. PLOT


ggplot(filter_combined_data, aes(x = clade, y = Average_Ingroup_Distance, fill = Gene_type)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Gene_type), 
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.75), 
             alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5, width = 0.7) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "dS values",
    x = "Clade",
    y = "dS"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = NULL, labels = c("Ancestral", "Autosomal", "Neo")) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") + # Matches the jitter points to the boxes
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.2)) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )
```



## 6. Statistical analysis
```{r}
# Overall test per clade
kw <- filter_combined_data %>%
  group_by(clade) %>%
  kruskal_test(Average_Ingroup_Distance ~ Gene_type)

# Pairwise comparisons per clade
pw <- filter_combined_data %>%
  group_by(clade) %>%
  wilcox_test(Average_Ingroup_Distance ~ Gene_type, p.adjust.method = "holm")
```


## 7. Plot with statistical significance
```{r}

# Pairwise tests (as before), plus bracket positions for a dodged boxplot
pw <- filter_combined_data %>%
  group_by(clade) %>%
  wilcox_test(Average_Ingroup_Distance ~ Gene_type, p.adjust.method = "holm") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "clade", dodge = 0.75)

ggplot(filter_combined_data, aes(x = clade, y = Average_Ingroup_Distance)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Gene_type),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.75),
             alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Gene_type), alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA,
               width = 0.7, position = position_dodge(0.75)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(pw, label = "p.adj.signif", hide.ns = TRUE,
                     tip.length = 0.01, step.increase = 0.03) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "dS values", x = "Clade", y = "dS") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = NULL,
                    labels = c("Ancestral", "Autosomal", "Neo")) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.25)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )
```
